notes_for_editor: Thin, mostly Lighthouse Friends (secondary, copyrighted: paraphrased) plus Alex Hickey's blog. Parks Canada's DFHD page did not load through the reader, so its statement is cited via Hickey's reproduction. Hubert Myles/Fiander dates are 1963 only. Ownership conflicts: LF says Coast Guard; Hickey says the island was signed over to the Heritage Corporation (check current owner). Generator building dated 1960 (Parks Canada text) vs 1970 (LF). Heritage-lighthouse year: record says 2016, not verified. The Marine branch reports in the corpus returned no usable hits for St. Jacques Island (OCR noise from Jacques Cartier); keeper list and 1907-08 works not checked against them. The 1964 Newfoundland Woman article (MUN) could not be fetched (SSL error). The 1916 collision: Hickey says Burke 'likely died on impact'; no date beyond July/late July 1916. Eric Fiander's date of death (20 Dec 1963) is from a Find a Grave/Ancestry search snippet, not used in the story.
